task.description: Design a scoped diagnosability improvement for ISS-0524 (non-reproducible discovery failure): richer error message with captured output, plus a bounded single retry on empty discovery.

result.note: Scope confined to discover_wasm_hang_tests/0 in lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check.test.ex. extract_test_list_block/1's parsing, install_wasm_hang_aware_fake_mix/1's fixture, all real @tag :wasm_hang sites, try_acquire-style logic, and the zero-tolerance policy itself all explicitly declared untouched. Retry decision: yes, exactly one bounded retry, justified by the module's own existing DEVIATION comment documenting ExUnit's non-deterministic compile-warning interleaving around this exact subprocess, cheap dry-run cost, and the retry can only delay a hard-fail by one call, never turn a real failure into a false pass. New type wasm_hang_discovery_attempt (output + parsed lines). Revised behavior: first attempt succeeds -> return immediately, no added latency on the common path; first empty -> info log, retry once; retry succeeds -> return + recovery info line; retry also empty -> Mix.raise with existing framing plus the retry attempt's raw output (last 40 lines via new last_output_lines/2 helper, with explicit truncation marker and explicit no-output wording). Test design specified: two new fake-mix fixtures via call-counting marker file (install_wasm_hang_retry_succeeds_fake_mix/1, install_wasm_hang_retry_still_fails_fake_mix/1), covering message-contains-real-output, truncation at >40 lines, retry-succeeds end-to-end pass with info-line assertion, retry-exhausted hard-fail with exactly-two-invocations assertion, and a regression check on the existing unmodified passing-path fixture. docs/issues/ISS-0524.yaml updated via append-only Edit (notes: list with ISSUE-FIXER's non-reproduction finding and this scoped decision), status left open. Self-check: grep for defmodule|def |defp |schema "|Enum.|fn ->|case do|cond do|with do|pipe operator returned zero matches.
